theme: The Hearth's shield. Solves problems with force.

kin_passive.name: Hold the Line
kin_passive.description: Reduce damage taken in personal combat by 1 each round.

ironkin_passive.name: Plated Bulwark
ironkin_passive.description: Reduce damage taken in personal combat by 2 each round, but each hit adds Wear.

theme: The frontier eyes. Solves problems with information and positioning.

kin_passive.name: Sharp Senses
kin_passive.description: Reads enemies more clearly in combat (+2 to the read).

ironkin_passive.name: Sensor Suite
ironkin_passive.description: Reads enemies even more clearly in combat (+3 to the read).

theme: The Ancestors' hands. Solves problems with tech and relics.

kin_passive.name: Tinker's Eye
kin_passive.description: Hull repairs cost 1 Ore less per point.

ironkin_passive.name: Self-Maintenance
ironkin_passive.description: Repair 25 of your own Wear for free once per journey.

theme: The voice of the Kin. Solves problems with oaths and deals.

kin_passive.name: Oath-Weight
kin_passive.description: NPCs take your promises more seriously.

ironkin_passive.name: Unbreakable Word
ironkin_passive.description: Kept oaths give extra reputation; broken oaths hurt more.
